title: fix(ai): infer the batch schema from every unique row

files.patch:
@@ -450,7 +450,9 @@ def _build_unique_rows_table(self) -> Tuple[Any, Dict[str, List[int]]]:
             if hasattr(native_data, "with_columns"):  # Polars
                 import polars as pl
 
-                unique_df = pl.DataFrame(unique_rows)
+                # Scan every row for the schema: a column that is null in the first rows
+                # would otherwise be typed as null and reject a later value
+                unique_df = pl.DataFrame(unique_rows, infer_schema_length=None)
             elif hasattr(native_data, "assign"):  # Pandas
                 import pandas as pd

@@ -229,6 +229,22 @@ def test_data_batcher_invalid_columns(sample_pd_data):
         _DataBatcher(sample_pd_data, columns=["nonexistent"])
 
 
+def test_create_batches_polars_column_null_in_first_unique_rows():
+    """A column that is null in the first 100 unique rows must still be batched."""
+    df = pl.DataFrame(
+        {
+            "id": list(range(150)) + [150],
+            "note": [None] * 150 + ["late text"],
+        }
+    )
+
+    batches, _ = _DataBatcher(df).create_batches()
+
+    notes = [row["note"] for batch in batches for row in batch["data"]["rows"]]
+    assert len(notes) == 151
+    assert notes[-1] == "late text"
+
+
